featured.title: Engineering starts long before production begins.
featured.body1: A sandwich panel factory is a system, not a purchase. Before a single coil is ordered, our engineers define target output, panel spectrum, plant footprint, utilities and logistics — then engineer the line around that reality.
featured.body2: The result is a factory that meets its stated capacity on day one, operates predictably for decades, and adapts as your market changes.

s1.p: NEVO Industrial ("NEVO", "we", "us") is an engineering and industrial group headquartered in Dubai, UAE. This policy explains how we handle personal data collected through our website, calculators, download center, and customer or partner portals.

items: Contact details you submit through inquiry forms, downloads, or callbacks.
Project parameters entered into calculators or configurators.
Account data for the customer and partner portals.
Technical data (IP address, device, browser, pages viewed) via essential and optional analytics cookies.

s3.p: We use personal data to respond to inquiries, deliver quotations, provide engineering documentation, operate portals, improve our platform, and comply with legal obligations. We do not sell personal data.

s4.p: We use essential cookies required for the site to function and optional analytics cookies to understand usage. You can accept or decline optional cookies via the consent banner and change your choice at any time by clearing site data.

s5.p: We share data only with service providers who help operate our platform (hosting, analytics, email delivery), and with NEVO group entities involved in delivering your project. All processors are bound by confidentiality obligations.

s6.pBefore: Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, or portability of your personal data, and object to certain processing. To exercise your rights, contact

s7.pBefore: NEVO Industrial — Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
s7.pAfter: with any questions about this policy.
